title: Keeble v. Hickeringill
text: Plaintiff owned land with a decoy pond where he took ducks for profit; defendant fired guns to scare away the ducks. Court found for the plaintiff.
facts: The plaintiff owned land containing a pond, where the plaintiff always takes ducks for a profit.
The defendant, knowing about the decoy pond, fired the guns to scare away the ducks in the pond.

title: Pierson v. Post
text: Plaintiff chased a fox in open land; defendant killed it and carried it away. Court found for the defendant who was hunting in open land.
facts: The plaintiff chased a fox in an open land.
The defendant killed it and carried it away.

title: Acme v. Borealis (distractor)
text: Supplier invoked a termination clause; court held the contract term had simply expired, not been breached.
facts: The supplier invoked the termination clause.
